<description>
In `blocks_relay_conn_tests`, the check that a transaction submitted over RPC is not announced to a block-relay-only peer looks for its txid among the peer's invs. The peer is a `P2PTxInvStore`, which negotiates wtxidrelay, so an announcement would carry the wtxid. The MiniWallet transaction has a witness, so its txid and wtxid differ, and the check passes whether or not the node announces it.

This checks the wtxid instead. To see the difference, open that connection as `outbound-full-relay`: the old check still passes, the new one fails.

#35920 also edits `blocks_relay_conn_tests`; the two do not conflict.

Found while porting these tests to https://github.com/btclib-org/bitcoin-node-tests.

_*Written with LLM, a computer and the Internet; the mistakes, as usual, are all mine.*_
</description>

<commits>
d640122cf2 test: check the wtxid in p2p_blocksonly's block-relay-only inv assertion

The connection that checks a transaction submitted over RPC is not
announced to a block-relay-only peer uses P2PTxInvStore, which negotiates
wtxidrelay. The node would therefore announce the transaction by its
wtxid, and the assertion looked for the txid, which cannot be in the
store for a transaction carrying a witness: it passed whether or not the
transaction was announced.

Assert on the wtxid instead. With the connection opened as
outbound-full-relay rather than block-relay-only, the old assertion still
passes and the new one fails.
</commits>

+++ b/test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py
@@ -86,7 +86,7 @@ class P2PBlocksOnly(BitcoinTestFramework):
         # Ensure we disconnect if a block-relay-only connection sends us a transaction
         self.nodes[0].add_outbound_p2p_connection(P2PInterface(), p2p_idx=0, connection_type="block-relay-only")
         assert_equal(self.nodes[0].getpeerinfo()[0]['relaytxes'], False)
-        _, txid, _, tx_hex = self.check_p2p_tx_violation()
+        _, _, wtxid, tx_hex = self.check_p2p_tx_violation()
 
         self.log.info("Tests with node in normal mode with block-relay-only connection, sending an inv")
         conn = self.nodes[0].add_outbound_p2p_connection(P2PInterface(), p2p_idx=0, connection_type="block-relay-only")
@@ -112,7 +112,8 @@ class P2PBlocksOnly(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.nodes[0].setmocktime(int(time.time()) + 60)
 
         conn.sync_with_ping()
-        assert int(txid, 16) not in conn.get_invs()
+        # The peer negotiated wtxidrelay, so an announcement would carry the wtxid
+        assert int(wtxid, 16) not in conn.get_invs()
 
     def check_p2p_inv_violation(self, peer):
         self.log.info("Check that tx-invs from P2P are rejected and result in disconnect")
